metadata.scenario: A caller wants to know the business hours for the upcoming holiday weekend. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I'm just checking on the business hours for the upcoming holiday weekend. Hi Mary! I’d be happy to help with that. Could you tell me which holiday weekend you’re referring to? Yes, it's for this coming Labor Day weekend. Got it! For Labor Day, we will be open for regular hours on Friday from 7 AM to 7 PM, Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM. On Sunday, we’ll be available for on-call emergencies only, and closed on Monday for the holiday. Okay, that makes sense. So, if I need assistance on Sunday, I should call in case of an emergency? Exactly, just reach out and we'll have someone available to help. Great! I appreciate that. I also wanted to ask about my IV therapy schedule for next week. Sure! I see you had a visit yesterday. Would you like to keep the same schedule for next week? Yes, if possible. It really helps with my routine. Alright, I’ll confirm that for you. Would you prefer to have the same caregiver who visited yesterday? Yes, I find her really reassuring, especially with the IV procedure. I’ll make a note to ensure she’s scheduled for your appointments next week. Thank you! That would really help ease my anxiety. Absolutely, Mary. It’s important to us that you feel comfortable. Oh, and just to confirm, what’s the cost for the IV therapy session? The IV therapy administration is priced between $120 and $150 per session. Okay, thank you for that information. You’re welcome! Do you need assistance with anything else today? No, I think that covers everything for now. Perfect! I’ll follow up to confirm your caregiver and schedule, and we’ll take care of you. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help. It’s my pleasure, Mary! Have a great day and take care! You too, bye! Goodbye!
